description_en: Activates log delivery for a flow log
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter activate-flow-log --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --dry-run true --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --flow-log-id flowlog-m5evbtbpt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ActivateFlowLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Performs a dry run to check the request. The system does not activate log delivery.

- **false** (default): Sends the request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- **true**：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique token on your client for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the flow log instance
parameters.name: flow_log_id
